body:
Thank you so much for your fast reply and the short video. It led me one step further!

Is there a chance that in future development these masks can be reused _"everywhere"?_ In darktable, we can re-use a mask created in any tool of choice also in all(!) other tools.

**Example:**

My _bird_ was fine tuned in `[Local editing] > [Texture Boost / Sharpening]` and re-used in `... > [Local Contrast]` which appears below. But when I now decide to tweak `[Local editing] > [Color/Tone Correction]` I cannot re-use that same mask .... though it is also placed below the `[Local editing]` tab.

This behaviour implies the need to create a mask _always_ in the top tool, even when I  do not intend to use it at all. But later I may realize it would be good to use it _now_ ... but then I can't re-use a mask created below.
